You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From d3a3b0ba27fc46a48273f8f311e1b7fd751fcbc5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pavel Strnad <pavel_strnad@hotmail.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Dec 2017 10:28:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] tshark: fix pdml export for LUA cases - bug fix for wrong
 level introduced in SHA-1:b8ead953 - fix indent for Close off fake wrapper
 protocol
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Change-Id: Iccb10af8f3ac1604fc5582d730f2fd39ffaeb1c0
Reviewed-on: https://code.wireshark.org/review/24681
Petri-Dish: Stig Bjørlykke <stig@bjorlykke.org>
Tested-by: Petri Dish Buildbot
Reviewed-by: Stig Bjørlykke <stig@bjorlykke.org>
---
 epan/print.c | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)
 mode change 100644 => 100755 epan/print.c

diff --git a/epan/print.c b/epan/print.c
old mode 100644
new mode 100755
index 868d5792cd..09f5a334c2
--- a/epan/print.c
+++ b/epan/print.c
@@ -452,6 +452,7 @@ proto_tree_write_node_pdml(proto_node *node, gpointer data)
     if (wrap_in_fake_protocol) {
         /* Open fake protocol wrapper */
         fputs("<proto name=\"fake-field-wrapper\">\n", pdata->fh);
+        pdata->level++;
 
         print_indent(pdata->level + 1, pdata->fh);
     }
@@ -679,6 +680,7 @@ proto_tree_write_node_pdml(proto_node *node, gpointer data)
 
     /* Close off fake wrapper protocol */
     if (wrap_in_fake_protocol) {
+        print_indent(pdata->level + 1, pdata->fh);
         fputs("</proto>\n", pdata->fh);
     }
 }
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect handling of the indentation level when exporting PDML (Packet Description Markup Language) for LUA cases. Specifically, the level was not being incremented properly when opening a fake protocol wrapper, leading to incorrect formatting in the output. The patch fixes this by ensuring that the indentation level is correctly incremented when the fake protocol wrapper is opened and properly adjusted when closing it.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect handling of the indentation level when exporting PDML (Packet Description Markup Language) for LUA cases. Specifically, the level was not being incremented properly when opening a fake protocol wrapper, leading to incorrect formatting in the output. The patch fixes this by ensuring that the indentation level is correctly incremented when the fake protocol wrapper is opened and properly adjusted when closing it.
